bar_policy: Only completed bars; higher-timeframe values use the last completed H1, H4 and D1 bars.

features.name: trend_direction
features.definition: Sign of the vote from H1, H4 and D1 EMA(20) versus EMA(50) trends.

features.name: mtf_alignment
features.definition: Fraction of H1, H4 and D1 trend votes matching the composite direction; 0 when the vote is neutral.

features.name: structure_break
features.definition: 1 when latest completed M30 close exceeds prior 20-bar high; -1 below prior 20-bar low; otherwise 0.

features.name: liquidity_sweep
features.definition: 1 for a low sweep and close reclaim of prior 10-bar low; -1 for a high sweep and close reclaim below prior 10-bar high; otherwise 0.

features.name: sr_distance_atr
features.definition: (Latest close minus midpoint of prior 20-bar range) divided by ATR(14).

features.name: candle_body_atr
features.definition: (Latest completed close minus open) divided by ATR(14).

features.name: volatility_atr
features.definition: ATR(14) divided by latest completed close.

features.name: momentum
features.definition: (Latest close minus close five bars earlier) divided by ATR(14).

features.name: spread_atr
features.definition: Current full bid-ask spread divided by ATR(14).

features.name: session_code
features.definition: Approximate UTC sessions: 0 Asia/off, 1 London, 2 New York, 3 overlap.

caveats: This schema describes model inputs, not a complete trade authorization.
The service returns no calibrated win probability.
EA and training feature implementations must be kept in sync when this schema changes.
